transcript.text: Good morning, it's Vega here! It may be time for your medication. Have you already taken it?
Bills? I paid all the bills last week
I understand, sometimes things can get mixed up. Just to clarify, I'm here to check if you've taken your medication today. Would you like to take it now?
What bills are you on about now?
It seems there might be a bit of confusion. I'm referring to your medication, not bills. If you're unsure, would you like to check your medication box to see if today's dose is still there?
Just checking in to see if you've had a chance to look at your medication box. Have you been able to take your medication today?
I wasn't able to confirm whether you've taken today's medication, so I'll let your caregiver know to check in with you soon.
